from openpyxl import load_workbook
from openpyxl.styles import Font, Alignment
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

wb = load_workbook('sales_data.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

# Read header row
headers = {}
for cell in ws[1]:
    if cell.value is not None:
        headers[cell.column] = str(cell.value).strip().lower()

print('Headers:', {get_column_letter(c): n for c, n in headers.items()})

# Locate profit and revenue/sales columns (case-insensitive)
profit_col = None
revenue_col = None
for col, name in headers.items():
    if profit_col is None and 'profit' in name:
        profit_col = col
    if revenue_col is None and ('revenue' in name or 'sales' in name):
        revenue_col = col

# If no explicit profit column, derive from revenue - cost
derived_profit = False
if profit_col is None:
    cost_col = None
    for col, name in headers.items():
        if cost_col is None and 'cost' in name:
            cost_col = col
    if revenue_col is not None and cost_col is not None:
        profit_col = cost_col  # formula will compute (rev - cost) / rev
        derived_profit = True
        print(f'No profit column found; using revenue - cost (cost col {get_column_letter(cost_col)})')
    else:
        print('ERROR: Could not locate profit and revenue/sales columns')
        print('Columns available:', {get_column_letter(c): n for c, n in headers.items()})
        raise SystemExit(1)

print(f'Using profit column {get_column_letter(profit_col)} and revenue column {get_column_letter(revenue_col)}')

# Find first empty column for the new "Profit Margin" column
new_col = ws.max_column + 1
new_letter = get_column_letter(new_col)

# Add header
header_cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=new_col, value='Profit Margin (%)')
header_cell.font = Font(bold=True)
header_cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center')

# Add formula for each data row (rows 2..max_row)
formula_count = 0
for row in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    rev_cell = f'{get_column_letter(revenue_col)}{row}'
    if derived_profit:
        cost_cell = f'{get_column_letter(profit_col)}{row}'
        formula = f'=IF(OR({rev_cell}="",{rev_cell}=0),"",({rev_cell}-{cost_cell})/{rev_cell})'
    else:
        profit_cell = f'{get_column_letter(profit_col)}{row}'
        formula = f'=IF(OR({rev_cell}="",{rev_cell}=0),"",{profit_cell}/{rev_cell})'
    c = ws.cell(row=row, column=new_col, value=formula)
    c.number_format = '0.0%'
    formula_count += 1

print(f'Added column {new_letter} with {formula_count} profit margin formulas')
wb.save('sales_data.xlsx')
print('Saved sales_data.xlsx')
